*   **What makes it special:** It's a right proper good old knees-up, if I do say so! Seriously! It's literally a festival of colour. Think you've got a full face of make-up? Think again!  Everywhere you look – people, the streets, darling, EVERYTHING – is absolutely drenched in vibrant powdered colours! There's music, dancing, poetry readings, some proper brilliant street food, and absolutely buckets of jolly British cheer.  It's just breathtakingly joyful!  It’s got a lovely, proper, 'oh my goodness, where am I'? sort of magic to it..
*   **Vibe:** Pure, unadulterated JOY! It's utterly infectious. A bit cheeky, a bit cheeky with a dash of utter adoration. Be prepared to be covered in pink and mint green and let go of your inhibitions! 
*   **Where to go for it:**  Oxford (yes, really! they do a cracking one!), Jaipur, London... anywhere with a proper good community! Don’t be a fright, go and have a splash of a time!
